notes.title: RoboDo Update 1.04
notes.content:
Thank you all once again for your feedback and suggestions.

We made some minor updates and fixes.

- settings now don't reset
- added battery respawn button
- adjusted hands' respawn
- gun is easier to grab
- better game optimization 

Right now we are working on easier batteries grabbing mechanics, stay tuned for new updates ;)

notes.title: RoboDo Update 1.03
notes.content:
Thank you all once again for your feedback and suggestions.

We made some minor updates and fixes.

- Battery holder now have socket, so it is easier to place battery. 
- Added snap turning settings for you to change between: 15,30,45,90 degrees.
- Now you can switch between head oriented or controller oriented walking.
- Other minor bug fixes.


We are very honored to have such a great community. Thank you all once again for helping us make this game better ːsteamhappyː

tags.feature: - Battery holder now have socket, so it is easier to place battery.
- Added snap turning settings for you to change between: 15,30,45,90 degrees.
- Now you can switch between head oriented or controller oriented walking.

notes.title: RoboDo Update 1.02
notes.content:
Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions. 

We made some minor update to the game according to your suggestions.

- Updated physics: fixed bug when you are thrown in the air when stepping on objects.
- Fixed tutorial descriptions
- Index bindings: now you pick up stuff and climb using trigger button. 
- Fixed head model visible line

Update that we are working right now:

- Changeable walking mode: head oriented or controller oriented.
- More convenient object pick up
- Hand animations

You can still test and try our game demo in our discord: https://discord.gg/87CTCx3
